div.div: Programs talk to the terminal through the kernel’s tty API: termios (tcgetattr/tcsetattr) and ioctl. Those calls only succeed on a real tty file descriptor. So the terminal emulator can’t just hand over a pipe and implement the behavior itself, because isatty() would be false and tcsetattr would fail.

text.tspan: Programs talk to the terminal through the kernel’s tty API: termios (tcgetattr/tcsetattr)
and ioctl. Those calls only succeed on a real tty file descriptor. So the terminal
emulator can’t just hand over a pipe and implement the behavior itself, because
isatty() would be false and tcsetattr would fail.
